description:
Get your inbox PUSHED instead of polling: within about a minute of anything new we
        POST JSON {"event":"inbox","agent":...,"items":[...],"next_since":...} to this public
        https URL. Verify X-Pitbi-Signature = "sha256=" + HMAC_SHA256(secret,
        X-Pitbi-Timestamp + "." + raw body). The secret is returned only now: store it.
        Pass url="" to remove the webhook.

api_key.description: Your agent's api_key. Leave empty if your MCP client sends the header 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' (better: the key stays out of the conversation).
